title: Six-step reasoning chain from the atomic level to nucleated self-excitation

source_paper.title: Nucleated Self-Excitation: Conformational Propagation and Self-Sustained Excitation in Proteins, and a Universal Mechanism

claim: Nucleated self-excitation is not induced from biological phenomena; it grows out of the atomic level. Each step is established physical chemistry or a direct consequence thereof.

chain.name: conformational states
chain.statement: A protein possesses multiple local minima on its conformational energy landscape; each minimum corresponds to a (meta)stable conformational state; inter-state conversion requires crossing an activation barrier.

chain.name: duality of the excited state
chain.statement: A molecule in a high-energy conformational state is simultaneously an attenuator (spontaneous departure rate gamma, plus cellular degradation channels) and an exciter (template-induced conversion of a soluble molecule into the same state, rate beta). The excited state is at once a loss source and a gain source — the atomic definition of self-excitation.

chain.name: competition of two rates
chain.statement: Rate ratio R = beta/gamma: expected new excitations per excited molecule during its lifetime, against its expected dissipation.

chain.name: crossing one
chain.statement: R<1: chain decays (fluctuation). R=1: critical. R>1: self-sustaining propagation (gain chain). Lag phase = accumulation before crossing; seed-dose effect = forward shift of crossing time by injected excitations.
chain.basis: branching process / epidemic R0=beta/gamma structure (same quantity, not analogy)

chain.name: population coherence to macroscopic nucleation
chain.statement: Excitation-transfer events accumulate into macroscopic ordered structure (fibrils, condensates): molecular fluctuation (short residence) converts to macroscopic structure (long residence) — the nucleation divide. Boundary stated honestly: R>1 is necessary, not sufficient; spatial coherence into a supracritical nucleus additionally requires classical-nucleation conditions (surface-energy barrier, critical nucleus size, Ostwald regimes).

chain.name: cross-domain bridge
chain.statement: The structure — medium units excited, exciting neighbors, gain against decay, collective mode established — does not depend on protein chemistry; generalized to ecology, epidemiology, phase separation; the field-medium (wave) form is the companion paper's subject.
chain.basis: invariance of R=beta/gamma across instantiated domains (paper section 5)

three_layer_criterion.maintenance: dual survival conditions (structural residence x replication commitment; four quadrants)

testable_prediction.statement: Branching approximation N(t) ~ S0 * exp((beta-gamma)t) gives t_lag = [1/(beta-gamma)] * ln(N_det/S0): lag linear in ln(S0) with mechanically interpretable slope.
testable_prediction.first_round_data: four literature systems log-linear (R2_ln >= 0.93 in 4/4; delta AIC <= -10 in 3/4); beta-gamma inversions all positive; independent cross-check lambda_theory/lambda_fit = 1.23 (paper section 4.1b)

companion_paper_field_form.title: Nucleated Self-Excitation Pass-Through: The Exchange Account of Two Kinds of Motion and the Pass-Through Spectrum
